run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T07:17:24Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is caused by HTTP 500s on POST /api/checkout, which fail inside the checkout → shipping quote path. The shipping Deployment was rolled out at 07:16:04-07:16:11 by a new ReplicaSet, and its pod template now sets QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" where the previous ReplicaSet had QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", with the same image. The new shipping pod's outbound quote POST span fails immediately (10 µs) with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))), its /get-quote server span answers 500 "Internal Server Error", checkout returns gRPC 13 INTERNAL "shipping quote failure...", and the frontend returns 500. Frontend error spans were zero through 07:16:24 and first appear at 07:17:24, the alert's start. Observed as affected: frontend (its own 500 error spans), checkout (its own PlaceOrder/HTTP POST error spans), shipping (own /get-quote and POST error spans, malformed address). Checked and not showing errors: quote (no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series; its calls stop after 07:16), payment (ERROR series 0), cart (flagd EventStream ERROR 0), email (only UNSET series), currency (StatusCode OK), product-catalog/cart calls in the failing trace returned grpc status 0. flagd features flags are all defaultVariant off, so flag-driven fault injection is not what is failing. The exact alert expression could not be verified because the rule was not found in Prometheus.

claims.text: Frontend error spans were 0 through the 07:16:24 point and first became nonzero at 07:17:24 (16.84 per 10m) on POST /api/checkout and its child spans executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and POST (operation POST, service frontend); they rose to ~359 per 10m by 07:27:24, while frontend error counts for GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations, POST /api/cart, dns.lookup and tcp.connect stayed at 0.

100% of frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans were STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 07:29:24, versus 0% at 07:10:24, so the checkout call path from the frontend failed completely after the change and not before it.

Trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c shows the failure chain on one request: frontend POST and POST /api/checkout returned http.status_code 500; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder returned rpc.grpc.status_code 13 with message "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"; shipping span /get-quote had status ERROR with description "Internal Server Error"; the child client span of shipping, operation "POST " (trailing space), failed in 10 µs with otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))".

The shipping Deployment's current pod template sets env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" (the replacement ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8, created 2026-11-17T07:16:04Z, 1 desired and 1 ready replica), while the earlier ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 2026-11-17T06:39:33Z, now 0 replicas) had QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080"; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, and both ReplicaSets are owned by Deployment shipping.

Pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is owned by ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8, runs with QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000", image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping (imageID sha256:9fb2bd7960a25a9876ab45d8ed627f73e606107b28eab02c579a5f2df72d2d90), restartCount 0, container started 2026-11-17T07:16:11Z.

The shipping pod change was a controller-driven rollout, not a crash: Deployment shipping ScalingReplicaSet scaled shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1 at 07:16:04Z and shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0 at 07:16:11Z; Pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn was Scheduled 07:16:04Z, Created 07:16:09Z, Started 07:16:11Z; old pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q received Killing at 07:16:11Z; ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 SuccessfulCreate and shipping-75d58f5d84 SuccessfulDelete at those times.
The newest 60 of 339 shipping container log lines (2026-11-17T07:23:27Z to 07:25:05Z) were all the text "Requesting quote", matching repeated quote attempts by the shipping pod.

New error-status spans in the 06:17-07:31 window appeared for checkout (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, HTTP POST), shipping (/get-quote, "POST "), frontend (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) and frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress); a steady ~1.05 per 10m of flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error spans already ran on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation before 07:17:24.

Quote service span counts (POST /getquote, calculate-quote, {closure}) fell from ~382 per 10m at 07:15:24 to 0 at 07:27:24, and the 06:37-07:31 query returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series for quote with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, i.e. quote stopped being called rather than reporting errors.

Checked dependencies showed no error status of their own: payment's STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect were 0 at every sampled point 06:52-07:27; cart's flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was 0; email returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series; currency's Currency/Convert spans were STATUS_CODE_OK and, in the failing trace, cart and product-catalog calls returned rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

All 21 otel-demo pods were Running at query time; frontend-675fd7b5c5-lmznt (started 06:39:32Z), checkout-5dccddf8bb-7gfz7 (06:39:32Z), quote-6b5877698d-6spfl (06:39:33Z) and email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn (06:39:32Z) all had restart count 0; shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn was the only pod with a start time near the incident (07:16:04Z), and otel-demo events contained only shipping Pod/ReplicaSet/Deployment activity.

Every flag in the flagd-config ConfigMap (including adFailure, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage) has defaultVariant "off".

A span-based proxy for the frontend error share was 5.20% at 07:29:24 (100 * increase of frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans / increase of all frontend spans over 10m), which does not reproduce the alert annotation's value 1.7777777777777777, so the alert's own metric expression is not established by this evidence.

The invalid shipping setting is the trigger: QUOTE_ADDR changed from "http://quote:8080" to "quote:0000" in the shipping pod template rolled out at 07:16:04Z; the new pod's quote request URL cannot be parsed (InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)), so /get-quote returns 500 immediately, checkout PlaceOrder fails with gRPC 13, and frontend's POST /api/checkout returns 500, producing the RequestErrorRate alert from 07:17:24Z.

Hypothesis rejected: the quote service itself is failing. Quote returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR span series in the window, its pod was Running with restart count 0, and shipping's outbound POST failed in 10 µs with a client-side InvalidUri(InvalidFormat) error before any request could reach quote; quote's traffic simply stopped after 07:16.

Hypothesis rejected: the email service is failing (suggested by the text "failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"). Email produced only STATUS_CODE_UNSET span series, its pod was Running with restart count 0, and its send_order_confirmation/send_email counts fell to 0 by 07:27:24 because checkout aborts before calling email; the only failing child span is shipping's outbound POST with InvalidUri.

Hypothesis rejected: a flagd-injected fault caused the errors. Every flag in flagd-config has defaultVariant "off", and the observed failure is a URI-format error inside shipping's own HTTP client rather than flag-gated behavior.

Hypothesis rejected: frontend or checkout is the originating fault. The frontend pod was unchanged since 06:39:32Z with restart count 0 and had no error spans through 07:16:24, and the 500 recorded by frontend is the propagated result of checkout's PlaceOrder failing at its shipping quote step.

Not every error in the window belongs to this cause: frontend-proxy ingress error spans ran at 3.6-9.5 per 10m from 06:53:24 to 07:15:24, before the alert, and ad, fraud-detection and recommendation carried a steady ~1.05 per 10m of flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error spans throughout; these are background and are not attributed to the shipping rollout.

gaps: The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was not present in the queried Prometheus rules view (list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned an empty result, status no_data), so the alert's exact PromQL expression and its reported value 1.7777777777777777 could not be reproduced or verified.

Metrics kube_pod_owner, kube_replicaset_owner and kube_pod_container_info returned no series under the queried selectors in this window, so the ownership chain and image digest were verified from the Kubernetes objects' ownerReferences/containerStatuses instead of those metric series.

The previous shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q and its logs no longer exist, so the pre-rollout pod's runtime behavior and the exact prior effective environment cannot be inspected beyond the old ReplicaSet's pod template.

The email container produced no readable log lines and quote logs were readable only through 07:16:08Z, so application-log confirmation from those pods after that time is missing; their assessment rests on spans and pod status.
Who or what applied the QUOTE_ADDR change to Deployment shipping at 07:16:04Z is unknown: change history is not an integrated data source in this Run.
Alert state after the 07:31:06Z window end (whether it recovered or continued) is unknown.

Events in namespace data-recorders (Job/PVC/PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete, FailedScheduling) were reviewed but no evidence ties them to the otel-demo frontend error path; their root cause was not investigated.
next_steps: Restore Deployment otel-demo/shipping's QUOTE_ADDR to the previously working value "http://quote:8080" (as recorded in ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84) and then confirm shipping /get-quote returns 200 and frontend POST /api/checkout stops returning 500.
Add validation or an admission check so QUOTE_ADDR must parse as a URI with a valid port before a shipping rollout is accepted.
Trace who applied the shipping Deployment change at 2026-11-17T07:16:04Z through a change-history/audit source, since change history is not integrated in this Run.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
